title: Vocabulary Growth Fundamentals: Bernstein Functions and Hausdorff Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2608.29449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We survey the theory of vocabulary growth founded in the setting of stochastic processes. In particular, we model the expected number of types through Bernstein functions and Hausdorff sequences. These classes of mathematical objects, defined by alternating signs of their derivatives or differences, can be related to continuous-time Poisson point processes and discrete-time IID processes, respectively. Building on previous accounts of the vocabulary growth, we integrate the broader theories of Bernstein functions and Hausdorff sequences and connect them with recently developed hapax rate models. In particular, we prove that the logistic hapax rate model has a non-negative spectrum and hence it defines a Bernstein function, thereby solving an earlier posed problem. We also analyze the limitations of the Bernstein--Hausdorff theory of the vocabulary growth by considering its generalizations under stationary and Weibull renewal processes.

translated_title: 词汇增长基础：Bernstein函数与Hausdorff序列
translated_abstract: 我们综述了在随机过程背景下建立的词汇增长理论。特别地，我们通过Bernstein函数和Hausdorff序列对类型期望数量进行建模。这两类数学对象分别由其导数或差分的符号交替定义，可分别与连续时间泊松点过程和离散时间独立同分布（IID）过程相关联。在以往词汇增长研究的基础上，我们整合了Bernstein函数和Hausdorff序列的更广泛理论，并将其与最近发展的孤词率模型联系起来。特别地，我们证明了logistic孤词率模型具有非负谱，因此它定义了一个Bernstein函数，从而解决了此前提出的一个问题。我们还通过考虑该理论在平稳过程和Weibull更新过程下的推广，分析了Bernstein–Hausdorff词汇增长理论的局限性。
tldr: 本文将Bernstein函数与Hausdorff序列理论融入词汇增长建模，证明了logistic孤词率模型具有非负谱从而构成Bernstein函数，解决了此前遗留的问题，并通过平稳过程和Weibull更新过程下的推广分析了该理论的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates Bernstein functions and Hausdorff sequences into vocabulary growth modeling, proves that the logistic hapax rate model has a non-negative spectrum and thus defines a Bernstein function—solving a previously posed problem—and analyzes the theory's limitations via generalizations under stationary and Weibull renewal processes.
